title: hieracium murorum subsp. tenuiflorum
intro: Hieracium murorum subsp. tenuiflorum, commonly known as Hawkweed, is a subspecies of plant in the dandelion family (Asteraceae) that is native to the mountainous regions of Europe. The plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Hawkweed may include wound healing, immune system support, and the treatment of various skin conditions due to its bioactive constituents, such as sesquiterpene lactones and flavonoids. However, further research is needed to confirm the efficacy and safety of using Hawkweed for medicinal purposes.
